title: MARKETING 4.0 — how the pieces communicate

edges.mechanism: shared pattern: LP SEO gate (metaTitle/description/JSON-LD) follows the same methodology; audited content is what the autoblog publishes
organic traffic via click; by contract the blog does NOT emit tracking links
at publication the LP creates the tracked CTA link; on conversion the LP records firstTrackingClickId on the lead (camelCase)
302 redirect; click recorded transactionally (RETURNING (xmax = 0)); analytics never blocks delivery
lead intake contract: 3-field lead (name + phone + email, bedrock clause) enters the 25-day sequence
every email CTA goes out as a mailmkt-<slug> tracked link
attribution ends at the purchase: the cookie records the origin (last-click, snake_case)

principles: Contracts, not SDKs — no piece imports another's code; each contract has a declared owner; the owner wins disputes
The physical communication is the data — columns, 302 redirects and cookies; no internal API calls
Absences are contracts too — the graph records what does NOT connect (the autoblog does not emit tracking links)
